verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm, so running the product headlessly or in CI is a category error for this kind of product. Its client tools (the SCC and Term Sheet generators) are interactive questionnaires built on Contract Express, and nothing in the pack shows a headless or CI mode that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
